flows.name: Visit the shop landing page
flows.start: On the public web address without being signed in
flows.goal: Understand this is the studio's own shop and start browsing in-stock pieces.

steps.userAction: The visitor opens the public shop address.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows this is the Jaipur studio's own ceramics shop, that ordering needs no account or messaging, and featured in-stock pieces with photos, price and how many are left or sold out, with choices to browse the full shop and to open a piece.

steps.userAction: The visitor chooses to browse the full shop.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the shop listing with all pieces, photos, prices and honest availability.

alternatives.condition: No pieces are in stock to feature.

steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the studio introduction and ordering without messaging, says no pieces are available right now, and keeps the choice to browse the full shop and check back later.

alternatives.condition: The shop listing has no pieces to show.

steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty shop listing saying no pieces are available right now, with a choice to return to the landing page and check back later.

alternatives.condition: The visitor chooses to open a featured piece instead of browsing the full shop.

steps.userAction: The visitor chooses a featured piece to open.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows that piece with its photos, price, description and glaze, size and availability choices.

flows.outcome: The visitor knows how to browse and order; nothing is stored and a refresh shows the same page.

flows.name: Browse pieces
flows.start: On the landing page or shop listing
flows.goal: Find an available mug, bowl, planter or vase in the catalog.

steps.userAction: The buyer chooses to browse the shop.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the shop listing with each Piece's photos, price, category and how many are left or sold out.

steps.userAction: The buyer types search words and picks a category to narrow the listing.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows only the Pieces that match the search words and category.

steps.userAction: The buyer chooses a Piece to view.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the Piece page with its details and glaze, size and quantity choices.

alternatives.condition: No Pieces are available to show.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says the shop has no pieces right now and invites the buyer to check back later.

alternatives.condition: No Pieces match the search words or the chosen category.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says nothing matches and offers to clear the search words and category to see all Pieces again.

alternatives.condition: The chosen Piece is no longer available.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says the piece is gone and shows the shop listing again.

flows.outcome: The buyer has found pieces that are actually available; a refresh shows the same listing with current stock.

flows.name: View a piece and choose options
flows.goal: See a piece's details and choose a glaze, size and quantity that is in stock.

steps.userAction: The buyer opens a Piece from the shop listing.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the Piece's photos, title, description, price and how many are left for each glaze-and-size variant, marking sold-out variants as sold out.

steps.userAction: The buyer picks a glaze, a size and a quantity.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows whether the chosen glaze-and-size variant is in stock, how many are left, and the total for the chosen quantity, and allows ordering only when the variant is in stock and the quantity is within the stock left.

alternatives.condition: The Piece is no longer available.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says the piece is gone and shows the shop listing again.

alternatives.condition: The chosen glaze-and-size variant is sold out.

steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the variant as sold out and does not allow it to be ordered, and invites the buyer to pick another glaze or size.

alternatives.condition: The quantity is empty, less than 1, or greater than the stock left for the chosen variant.

steps.websiteResponse: The website marks the quantity, keeps the chosen glaze and size, and explains only up to the stock left can be ordered.

flows.outcome: The buyer has seen the piece and a valid in-stock variant choice; nothing is saved yet and a refresh shows the same piece with current stock.

flows.name: Add piece to cart
flows.start: On a Piece page with a glaze, size and quantity chosen
flows.goal: Put a chosen in-stock variant in the cart.

steps.userAction: The buyer chooses to add the chosen glaze, size and quantity to the cart.
steps.websiteResponse: The website adds the variant and quantity to the cart kept in the browser and shows the updated cart count and total, and the buyer can continue browsing Pieces or go to review the cart.

alternatives.condition: The variant has no stock left or has less stock left than the wanted quantity.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says the variant just sold out or only the stock left remains, keeps the Piece page with current stock, and invites the buyer to pick another glaze, size or quantity.

flows.outcome: The cart holds the chosen variant and quantity; after a refresh the cart is still there.

flows.name: Review cart and update quantities
flows.start: On any shop page with items in the cart
flows.goal: Review the cart and correct quantities before ordering.
preconditions: Cart has at least one item.

steps.userAction: The buyer opens the cart.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows each cart line with piece title, glaze, size, price and quantity, and the cart total.

steps.userAction: The buyer changes the quantity of a cart line.
steps.websiteResponse: The website checks the stock left for the variant, updates the line quantity and shows the updated cart total.

steps.userAction: The buyer removes a cart line.
steps.websiteResponse: The website removes the line and shows the updated cart total.

steps.userAction: The buyer chooses to proceed to checkout.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the checkout with the cart summary and fields for name, phone, fulfilment choice, address and discount code.

alternatives.condition: The cart is empty.

steps.websiteResponse: The website shows that the cart is empty and offers to browse pieces.

alternatives.condition: The quantity is empty, zero, not a number, or greater than the stock left for the variant.

steps.websiteResponse: The website marks the quantity, keeps what was typed, explains how many are left for that glaze and size, and keeps the previous cart unchanged.

alternatives.condition: Updating the cart fails.

steps.websiteResponse: The website keeps the entered quantity and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: A cart variant has sold out or no longer has enough stock.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says which glaze and size is no longer available in the wanted quantity and asks the buyer to adjust the cart.

flows.outcome: The cart reflects the wanted quantities; after a refresh the same cart is shown.

flows.name: Place an order as guest
flows.goal: Place an order as a guest without paying online.
preconditions: Cart has at least one in-stock item.

steps.userAction: The buyer chooses to check out from the cart review.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the checkout with cart lines, subtotal, discount field, fields for name, phone, fulfilment choice and, for courier, delivery address, city and PIN code, the shipping rule of Rs 99 courier and free above Rs 1500 discounted subtotal and free pickup, and the studio pickup address and instructions.

steps.userAction: The buyer fills in name, phone, fulfilment choice, address when courier is chosen and optional discount code, and submits the order.
steps.websiteResponse: The website checks the discount code and stock, reduces the stock of each ordered variant, creates the order with an order reference, clears the cart, and shows the confirmation with reference, pieces with glaze, size and quantities, totals including discount and shipping, fulfilment choice with pickup instructions or delivery address, and the note that the owner will collect payment by UPI later.

alternatives.condition: The cart is empty.

steps.websiteResponse: The website shows that the cart is empty and offers to browse pieces.

alternatives.condition: The name is empty, the phone number is not a valid Indian phone number, no fulfilment choice is picked, or for courier delivery the delivery address, city or 6-digit PIN code is missing or wrong.

steps.websiteResponse: The website marks what is missing or wrong, keeps what was typed, and keeps the cart unchanged.

alternatives.condition: Placing the order fails.

steps.websiteResponse: The website keeps all entered values and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: The discount code is invalid, expired or deactivated.

steps.websiteResponse: The website rejects the code with a message, keeps the other entered values, and allows the buyer to correct the code or place the order without it.

alternatives.condition: A cart variant has sold out or the wanted quantity is greater than the stock left.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says which glaze and size is no longer available in the wanted quantity and asks the buyer to adjust the cart.

steps.userAction: The buyer returns to the cart.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the cart with current stock for each line.

flows.outcome: An Order is created with stock reduced; after a refresh the confirmation with reference and totals is still retrievable.

flows.name: Look up an order
flows.start: On the shop pages with an order reference
flows.goal: Find a placed order again with reference and phone number.

steps.userAction: The buyer opens order lookup.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the order lookup with fields for order reference and phone number.

steps.userAction: The buyer enters the order reference and phone number and submits them.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the order with pieces, glaze, size and quantities, totals with discount and shipping, fulfilment choice with studio pickup instructions or delivery address, and the note that the owner will collect payment by UPI later.

alternatives.condition: The order reference is empty or the phone number is empty or not a valid phone number.

steps.websiteResponse: The website marks what is missing or wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Looking up the order fails.

steps.websiteResponse: The website keeps the entered values and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: No order matches the entered reference and phone number.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says no order matches those values and offers to check the values and try again.

flows.outcome: The buyer has seen the order details; a refresh shows the same order.

flows.name: Owner sign up
flows.start: On the owner sign-in page while not signed in
flows.goal: Create the shop-owner account.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to sign up.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the owner sign-up form.

steps.userAction: The owner fills in the form and submits it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website creates the single shop-owner account, signs the owner in and shows the home dashboard with new orders and low-stock warnings.

alternatives.condition: The email is not an address or the password is shorter than 8 characters.

steps.websiteResponse: The website marks the email or password field and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Creating the account fails.

steps.websiteResponse: The website keeps the entered values and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: An owner account already exists or the email already has an account.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says only one shop-owner account is allowed and offers to sign in instead.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to sign in.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the owner sign-in form.

flows.outcome: The owner account exists and the owner is signed in; after a refresh they stay signed in.

flows.name: Owner sign in
flows.start: On the owner sign-in page while not signed in
flows.goal: Sign in to manage the shop.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to sign in.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the owner sign-in form.

steps.userAction: The owner fills in the form and submits it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website signs the owner in and shows the home dashboard with new orders and low-stock warnings.

alternatives.condition: The email is not an address or a field is empty.

steps.websiteResponse: The website marks the field and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Signing in fails.

steps.websiteResponse: The website keeps the entered email and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: The email and password match no owner account.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says the email or password is wrong, keeps the email and offers to try again.

flows.outcome: The owner is signed in; after a refresh they are still signed in on the dashboard.

flows.name: Owner sign out
flows.start: On any owner page while signed in
flows.goal: End the owner session.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to sign out.
steps.websiteResponse: The website ends the session and shows the public shop landing page.

flows.outcome: The owner is signed out; after a refresh they stay signed out.

flows.name: Owner home dashboard
flows.goal: See new orders and pieces running low at a glance.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the home dashboard.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows new orders clearly identifiable with counts and totals, and pieces whose variants have 3 or fewer left marked low-stock and 0 marked sold out, with options to open an order and to open a piece to edit stock.

alternatives.condition: There are no orders and no pieces yet.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says there are no orders yet and no pieces yet, and offers to add a piece and to open the order list.

flows.outcome: The owner has seen what needs packing and what needs making; a refresh shows current orders and stock.

flows.name: Browse pieces with stock
flows.goal: Find pieces and spot glazes and variants that are nearly gone.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to open the piece list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows all pieces with title, price, photos and per-variant stock with low-stock and sold-out marks.

steps.userAction: The owner enters search words and chooses an availability filter.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows only the pieces that match the search and filter.

steps.userAction: The owner opens a piece from the list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the piece's details with all glaze-and-size variants and stock quantities.

alternatives.condition: No pieces exist yet.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says no pieces exist yet and offers to add a piece.

alternatives.condition: No pieces match the search or filter.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says nothing matches and offers to clear the search and filter.

alternatives.condition: The piece was removed in the meantime.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says the piece is gone and shows the piece list again.

flows.outcome: The owner has found the wanted pieces and stock states; a refresh shows the same current list.

flows.name: Add a piece
flows.goal: Add a new ceramic piece with variants and stock.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to add a piece.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty piece form with fields for details, variants and stock.

steps.userAction: The owner fills in the piece details, adds one or more glaze-and-size variants with stock quantities, and saves the piece.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the piece and shows it in the piece list with its variants and stock.

alternatives.condition: A required value is missing or wrong, such as an empty title, a price below ₹1, a missing photo, a missing glaze or size, or a negative stock quantity.

steps.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Saving fails.

steps.websiteResponse: The website keeps the values and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancels.

steps.websiteResponse: Nothing is saved; the website shows the piece list as it was.

flows.outcome: The new Piece is saved and visible to buyers when in stock; after a refresh it is still there.

flows.name: Edit a piece and its stock
flows.goal: Change a piece's details, variants or stock.

steps.userAction: The owner opens a piece from the piece list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the piece's current details, variants and stock for editing.

steps.userAction: The owner changes the details, variants or stock quantities and saves the changes.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the changes and shows the updated piece with current stock.

alternatives.condition: The piece was removed in the meantime.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says the piece is gone and shows the piece list again.

alternatives.condition: A required value is missing or wrong, such as an empty title, a price below ₹1, a missing photo, a missing glaze or size, or a negative stock quantity.

steps.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Saving the changes fails.

steps.websiteResponse: The website keeps the values and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancels without saving.

steps.websiteResponse: Nothing is changed; the website shows the piece again as it was.

flows.outcome: The Piece changes are saved; after a refresh the updated piece and stock remain.

flows.name: Remove a piece
flows.goal: Remove a piece that will no longer be sold.

steps.userAction: The owner opens a piece from the piece list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the piece's details, variants and stock.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to remove the piece.
steps.websiteResponse: The website asks the owner to confirm removing the piece.

alternatives.condition: The piece was removed in the meantime.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says the piece is gone and shows the piece list again.

alternatives.condition: The owner confirms the removal.

steps.websiteResponse: The website removes the piece and shows the piece list without it; past orders keep their snapshot of it.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancels.

steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the piece again, unchanged.

flows.outcome: The Piece is gone from the shop and stays gone after a refresh; past Orders are unchanged.

flows.name: Browse orders by status
flows.goal: Find orders by status, newest first.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to view orders.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows orders newest first with New orders clearly identifiable, each with reference, buyer name, totals and fulfilment state.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses an order status filter.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows only orders with the chosen status, newest first.

steps.userAction: The owner opens an order from the list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the order's buyer, items, totals and fulfilment choice.

alternatives.condition: There are no orders yet.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says there are no orders yet and explains that new orders will appear here once buyers order from the shop.

alternatives.condition: No orders have the chosen status.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says no orders have this status and offers to choose another status.

alternatives.condition: The opened order is gone.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says the order is gone and shows the order list.

flows.outcome: The owner has found the wanted orders; a refresh shows the same current list.

flows.name: View an order
flows.goal: See an order's buyer, items, totals and where to send it.

steps.userAction: The owner opens an order from the order list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the order reference, buyer name and phone number, items with glaze, size, quantity and price, discount code and totals with shipping, fulfilment choice with delivery address, city and PIN code or studio pickup, and payment and fulfilment states.

alternatives.condition: The order no longer exists.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says the order is gone and shows the order list.

flows.outcome: The owner has seen the full order; a refresh shows the same current order.

flows.name: Mark order as paid
flows.goal: Record that UPI payment was collected for an order.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to mark the order as paid after collecting by UPI outside the app.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the order as Paid with the fulfilment state unchanged.

alternatives.condition: Marking the order as paid fails.

steps.websiteResponse: The website keeps the order as Unpaid and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: The order is already Paid.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says the order is already Paid and shows it unchanged.

flows.outcome: The Order is Paid and stays Paid after a refresh.

flows.name: Advance order fulfilment
flows.goal: Pack, ship or hand over orders.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to move the order to its next fulfilment state.
steps.websiteResponse: The website moves a New order to Packed, moves a Packed courier order to Shipped and a Packed pickup order to Picked Up, and shows the new fulfilment state.

alternatives.condition: Moving the order fails.

steps.websiteResponse: The website keeps the current fulfilment state and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: The order is Shipped, Picked Up or Cancelled.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says only New or Packed orders can be moved and shows the order unchanged.

flows.outcome: The Order's fulfilment state is advanced; after a refresh the new state remains.

flows.name: Create a discount code
flows.goal: Create a discount code with an amount and end date.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to create a discount code.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty discount code form.

steps.userAction: The owner fills in the code, discount type, discount value and expiry date and saves it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the code as active and shows it in the discount list.

alternatives.condition: The code is empty, the discount value is missing or less than 1, a percentage value is greater than 100, or the expiry date is missing or in the past.

steps.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Saving the code fails.

steps.websiteResponse: The website keeps the entered values and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: The code text is already used by another discount code.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says the code already exists and keeps what was typed so it can be changed.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancels without saving.

steps.websiteResponse: Nothing is saved; the website shows the discount list as it was.

flows.outcome: The DiscountCode is active and usable; after a refresh it is still listed.

flows.name: Browse discount codes
flows.goal: Review promotion codes and their state.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the discount codes.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows all discount codes newest first, each with its code, discount type, discount value, expiry date and active or deactivated state.

alternatives.condition: No discount codes exist yet.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says no discount codes exist yet and offers to create one.

flows.outcome: The owner has seen all codes and states; a refresh shows the same current list.

flows.name: Deactivate a discount code
flows.goal: Stop a promotion code from being used.
preconditions: At least one active DiscountCode exists.

steps.userAction: The owner opens an active discount code from the list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the code with its discount type, discount value, expiry date and active state.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to deactivate the code.
steps.websiteResponse: The website asks the owner to confirm deactivating the code.

alternatives.condition: The discount code is no longer available.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says the code is gone and shows the discount list.

alternatives.condition: The owner confirms the deactivation.

steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the code as deactivated in the discount list; the code will be rejected at checkout.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancels the deactivation.

steps.websiteResponse: Nothing changes; the website shows the code again still active.

alternatives.condition: Deactivating the code fails.

steps.websiteResponse: The website keeps the code active and offers to try again.

flows.outcome: The code is deactivated and stays deactivated after a refresh.

flows.name: Manage owner account
flows.start: On any owner page while signed in
flows.goal: Manage the owner's own sign-in details.

steps.userAction: The owner opens their account.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the owner's email and a field to enter a new password.

steps.userAction: The owner enters a new password and saves it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the new password and shows the account again with a confirmation.

alternatives.condition: The new password is shorter than 8 characters.

steps.websiteResponse: The website marks the password field, clears it and asks to enter a password of at least 8 characters.

alternatives.condition: Saving the new password fails.

steps.websiteResponse: The website keeps the account unchanged and offers to try again.

flows.outcome: Account changes are saved; after a refresh they remain and sign-in uses them.

flows.name: Cancel an order and restore stock
flows.goal: Cancel a New or Packed order and return its stock to sale.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to cancel the order.
steps.websiteResponse: The website asks the owner to confirm cancelling the order and restoring its stock to sale.

alternatives.condition: The owner confirms the cancellation.

steps.websiteResponse: The website marks the order Cancelled, restores the stock of each ordered variant so the pieces become orderable again, and shows the Cancelled order.

alternatives.condition: The owner does not confirm.

steps.websiteResponse: Nothing changes; the website shows the order unchanged.

alternatives.condition: The order is Shipped, Picked Up or already Cancelled.

steps.websiteResponse: The website says only New or Packed orders can be cancelled and shows the order unchanged.

alternatives.condition: Cancelling the order fails.

steps.websiteResponse: The website keeps the order unchanged and offers to try again.

flows.outcome: The Order is Cancelled with stock restored; after a refresh it stays Cancelled and the stock remains restored.

fields.label: Title
fields.meaning: How the piece is named in the shop

fields.label: Description
fields.meaning: What the piece is, how it is made and how it looks

fields.label: Price
fields.meaning: How much one unit of the piece costs in rupees

fields.label: Photos
fields.meaning: Pictures of the piece so buyers can see glaze and form

fields.label: Category
fields.meaning: Which kind of ceramics the piece is

fields.label: Glaze
fields.meaning: The glaze colour option of this variant

fields.label: Size
fields.meaning: The size option of this variant

fields.label: Stock quantity
fields.meaning: How many units are left for this glaze-and-size variant; 0 means sold out

fields.label: Quantity
fields.meaning: How many units of the chosen variant the buyer wants, no more than stock left

fields.label: Name
fields.meaning: Who placed the order and who collects or receives it

fields.label: Phone number
fields.meaning: How the owner contacts the buyer and how the buyer looks up the order

fields.label: Fulfilment choice
fields.meaning: Whether the buyer picks up at the Jaipur studio or gets a courier

fields.label: Delivery address
fields.meaning: Street address for courier delivery, required only for courier

fields.label: City
fields.meaning: City for courier delivery, required only for courier

fields.label: PIN code
fields.meaning: Postal code for courier delivery, required only for courier

fields.label: Discount code
fields.meaning: Promotional code typed at checkout for one discount per order

fields.label: Order reference
fields.meaning: Reference shown at confirmation used with phone number to find the order again

fields.label: Search pieces
fields.meaning: Words to find pieces by name or glaze

fields.label: Code
fields.meaning: The text buyers type at checkout to get the promotion

fields.label: Discount type
fields.meaning: Whether the code takes a percent or a fixed rupee amount off the subtotal

fields.label: Discount value
fields.meaning: How much the code takes off: percent when type is Percentage, rupees when Fixed amount

fields.label: Expiry date
fields.meaning: Last date the code can be used

fields.label: Email
fields.meaning: How the shop owner signs in

fields.label: Password
fields.meaning: Secret that protects the owner account

fields.label: Order status filter
fields.meaning: Which fulfilment states to show in the order list

fields.label: Availability filter
fields.meaning: Which stock states to show in the piece list

assumptions.text: The cart is kept in the buyer's browser and is cleared after the Order is placed. Stock is checked again at checkout, so a variant that sold out while in the cart cannot be ordered.
Deleting a Piece does not delete past Orders that contain it. Orders keep a snapshot of piece name, glaze, size, quantity and price for the owner's records.
There is a single shop-owner account. Buyers never sign in and owners never place Orders.
